title: IPsec pcap ground-truth label
description: Ground truth attached to every pcap produced by the M2 testbed. Per-variant fields are derived from testbed/matrix.py; per-pcap fields (traffic_type, source, run_id, duration_s, packet_count) are attached by the capture manifest. 'variant': plain marks non-IPsec negatives, whose remaining IPsec fields are all none/0/false.

variant.description: Variant id from testbed/matrix.py, or 'plain' for non-IPsec negatives.

ipsec_protocol.description: IPsec protocol of the CHILD SA (labelled on the wire as IP proto 50/51).

ike_version.description: IKE version used by this variant's IKE SA.

mode.description: IPsec mode of the CHILD SA.

encryption.description: Encryption algorithm of the CHILD SA ('none' for AH and negatives).

key_length_bits.description: Symmetric key length in bits (168 = 3DES effective key size; 0 = none).

auth.description: Integrity algorithm ('aead' when integrity is provided by the AEAD cipher, 'none' for negatives).

aead.description: True when the cipher provides authentication itself (GCM family).

dh_group.description: IKE DH group (2/5 weak, 14/19/20 modern; 0 = negatives). The CHILD SA uses the same group for PFS iff pfs is true.

pfs.description: Perfect forward secrecy: a DH group appears in the CHILD SA proposal (applied at CREATE_CHILD_SA rekey for IKEv2, first quick mode for IKEv1).

esn.description: Extended sequence numbers on the CHILD SA (kernel XFRM_STATE_ESN).

replay_window.description: XFRM replay window size in packets; 0 = replay protection disabled.

nat_t.description: ESP-in-UDP encapsulation enforced (swanctl encap=yes / ipsec.conf forceencaps=yes).

ike_rekey_s.description: IKE SA rekey interval in seconds (0 = negatives).

child_rekey_s.description: CHILD SA rekey interval in seconds (0 = negatives).

ip_version.description: IP version of the protected traffic and IKE exchange (4 or 6; also set for negatives).

traffic_type.description: Synthetic traffic profile mixed into this capture (spec M2 set).

source.description: 'real' = captured from a live testbed, 'synthetic' = generated by synth_pcap.py (never mix the two in one training split without declaring it).

run_id.description: Capture run identifier; group key for train/test splits (splits must be grouped by run, decision D6).
